134: class SnapshotLifecycle:
135:     """Exclusive per-snapshot policy, pending a real kernel protection port."""
136: 
137:     def __init__(self, kernel_port=None):
138:         self._kernel = kernel_port
139:         self._lock = RLock()
140:         self._records = {}
141: 
142:     def read_lease(self, store_root, choice, revision):
143:         if self._kernel is None:
144:             raise LifecycleUnavailable("Windows snapshot protection is unavailable")
145:         if any(type(value) is not str or not value or len(value) > 4096
146:                for value in (store_root, choice, revision)):
147:             raise LifecycleUnavailable("Snapshot identity refused")
148:         # Canonical root/ancestor containment, identity and writer exclusion
149:         # remain mandatory kernel-port checks before acquire_read can return.
150:         return _Lease(self, SnapshotKey(store_root, choice, revision))
151: 
152:     def _quarantine(self, record, reason):
153:         # Caller holds _lock. Keep protection/permit/owner references alive.
154:         record.phase = Phase.QUARANTINED
155:         record.reason = reason
156:         record.quarantine_persisted = False
157:         if record.owner is not None:
158:             record.owner._revoked = True
159:         try:
160:             recorded = self._kernel.quarantine(record.key, record.protection, record.permit, reason)
161:         except BaseException as exc:
162:             record.quarantine_failure_type = type(exc).__name__
163:             if not isinstance(exc, Exception):
164:                 raise
165:             raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Quarantine persistence is unconfirmed; local record remains blocked") from exc
166:         if recorded is not True:
167:             record.quarantine_failure_type = "UnconfirmedReturn"
168:             raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Quarantine persistence is unconfirmed; local record remains blocked")
169:         record.quarantine_persisted = True
170:         record.quarantine_failure_type = None
171: 
172:     def _quarantine_preserving(self, record, reason, original):
173:         # Keep the first error/interruption while recording failed persistence.
174:         try:
175:             self._quarantine(record, reason)
176:         except BaseException as quarantine_error:
177:             original.add_note("Snapshot remains locally quarantined; durable quarantine attempt failed: "
178:                               + type(quarantine_error).__name__)

180:     def require_writer_protection(self, store_root, choice, revision):
181:         key = SnapshotKey(store_root, choice, revision)
182:         with self._lock:
183:             record = self._records.get(key)
184:             if record is not None and record.phase is not Phase.RELEASED:
185:                 raise SnapshotBusy("Snapshot is leased or quarantined")
186:         # No successful path until an actual writer/publish/delete port exists.
187:         raise LifecycleUnavailable("Writer protection and publication are not implemented")

251:                 if isinstance(exc_value, BaseException):
252:                     manager._quarantine_preserving(record, "Lease exited with native work or protection unconfirmed", exc_value)
253:                     return False
254:                 manager._quarantine(record, "Lease exited with native work or protection unconfirmed")
255:                 raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Snapshot remains quarantined")
256:             try:
257:                 released = manager._kernel.release_read(record.protection)
258:             except BaseException as release_error:
259:                 original = exc_value if isinstance(exc_value, BaseException) else release_error
260:                 manager._quarantine_preserving(record, "Snapshot protection release raised", original)
261:                 if isinstance(exc_value, BaseException):
262:                     original.add_note("Snapshot protection release raised: " + type(release_error).__name__)
263:                     return False
264:                 raise
265:             if released is not True:
266:                 if isinstance(exc_value, BaseException):
267:                     manager._quarantine_preserving(record, "Snapshot protection release was not confirmed", exc_value)
268:                     return False
269:                 manager._quarantine(record, "Snapshot protection release was not confirmed")
270:                 raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Snapshot remains quarantined")
271:             record.phase = Phase.RELEASED
272:             record.protection = None
273:             return False

227: class ReservationService:
228:     """Ports belong to trusted generated bootstrap, never serialized profiles.
229: 
230:     open_journal(physical) returns an already-retained journal port.
231:     observe_worker(worker) validates a live retained owner and returns PID/time.
232:     confirm_teardown(worker, evidence) must independently validate exact live
233:     ownership, zero pending work and completed guard retirement. No disk value
234:     is passed as evidence. Real versions of these ports are not implemented.
235: 
236:     confirm_live_reconciliation(worker, physical, generation, head, attempt) is
237:     a separate trusted observer fixed at construction. It must freshly confirm
238:     the exact retained owner is stopped, no work/I/O remains, and guards have
239:     retired. It binds these observations to this unique attempt and current
240:     physical/generation/head. Recorded identities and earlier receipts cannot
241:     satisfy it. This callback does not acquire ownership from a recorded PID.
242:     """
243:     def __init__(self, gates, open_journal, observe_worker, confirm_teardown,
244:                  confirm_live_reconciliation=None):
245:         self.gates, self._open, self._observe, self._finish = gates, open_journal, observe_worker, confirm_teardown
246:         self._reconcile_live = confirm_live_reconciliation
247:         self._live = {}
248: 
249:     def begin(self, physical, semantic, generation, new_snapshot_evidence=None):
250:         gate = self.gates.acquire(physical)
251:         token = Reservation(self, physical, semantic, generation, gate, None, b"")
252:         self._live[gate] = token
253:         try:
254:             token.journal = self._open(physical)
255:             token.raw = token.journal.read_all()
256:             # Empty state requires a private bootstrap registry entry; no
257:             # caller-provided dataclass/profile can register a new snapshot.
258:             if token.raw == b"":
259:                 self.gates.consume_creation(physical, gate, new_snapshot_evidence)
260:                 token.raw = token.journal.append_confirmed(b"", encode_next(b"", physical, semantic, None, "INITIALIZED"))
261:             else:
262:                 rows, head = decode_journal(token.raw)
263:                 _require(rows[-1]["physical"] == physical.wire(), "physical_record_mismatch")
264:                 _require(rows[-1]["phase"] in ("INITIALIZED", "CLEARED") and self.gates.known_clean(physical, gate, head),
265:                          "restart_reconciliation_required")
266:             token.raw = token.journal.append_confirmed(token.raw, encode_next(token.raw, physical, semantic, generation, "RESERVED"))
267:             with token._lock:
268:                 self._owned(token)
269:                 _require(not token.revoked and token.phase == "RESERVED", "reservation_revoked_before_publication")
270:                 return token
271:         except BaseException as exc:
272:             token.phase, token.persistence_failure = "QUARANTINED", type(exc).__name__
273:             token.revoked = True
274:             # Keep both gate and any partial journal ownership. No fake unlock.
275:             raise

350:                      and token.worker is None, "worker_binding_order")
351:             token.worker = worker
352:             operation = token.pending = object()
353:         try:
354:             observed = self._observe(worker)
355:             frame = encode_next(token.raw, token.physical, token.semantic, token.generation,
356:                                 "WORKER_BOUND", process=observed)
357:             after = token.journal.append_confirmed(token.raw, frame)
358:             with token._lock:
359:                 self._owned(token)
360:                 token.raw, token.pending = after, None
361:                 _require(not token.revoked and token.phase == "RESERVED", "worker_binding_revoked_before_publication")
362:                 token.phase = "WORKER_BOUND"
363:         except BaseException as exc:
364:             with token._lock:
365:                 if token.pending is operation:
366:                     token.pending = None
367:                 token.revoked = True
368:                 token.phase, token.persistence_failure = "QUARANTINED", type(exc).__name__
369:             raise
370: 
371:     def require_resume(self, token):
372:         self._owned(token)
373:         with token._lock:
374:             self._owned(token)
375:             _require(token.phase == "WORKER_BOUND" and token.pending is None and not token.revoked,
376:                      "durable_worker_binding_required_before_resume")
377: 
378:     def resume_owned(self, token, resume_callback):
379:         # The callback is the trusted fixed nonblocking native-resume port,
380:         # not an operation selected from IPC. No journal I/O occurs here.
381:         self._owned(token)
382:         with token._lock:
383:             self._owned(token)
384:             self.require_resume(token)
385:             _require(not token.resume_attempted, "single_owned_resume_attempt")
386:             token.resume_attempted = True
387:             try:
388:                 _require(resume_callback(token.worker) is True, "owned_resume_unconfirmed")
389:             except BaseException:
390:                 token.revoked, token.phase = True, "QUARANTINED"
391:                 token.revision += 1
392:                 raise
393: 
394:     def revoke_local(self, token):
395:         self._owned(token)
396:         with token._lock:
397:             self._owned(token)
398:             token.revoked, token.phase = True, "QUARANTINED"
399:             token.revision += 1
400: 
401:     def quarantine(self, token, reason):
402:         self._owned(token)
403:         with token._lock:
404:             self._owned(token)
405:             token.revoked, token.phase = True, "QUARANTINED"
406:             token.revision += 1
407:             if token.pending is not None:
408:                 token.persistence_failure = "PendingTransition"
409:                 return False
410:             operation = token.pending = object()
411:         try:
412:             rows, _ = decode_journal(token.raw)
413:             frame = encode_next(token.raw, token.physical, token.semantic, token.generation,
414:                                 "QUARANTINED", reason=reason, process=rows[-1]["process"])
415:             after = token.journal.append_confirmed(token.raw, frame)
416:             with token._lock:
417:                 self._owned(token)
418:                 token.raw, token.pending = after, None
419:                 token.persistence_failure = None
420:             return True
421:         except BaseException as exc:
422:             with token._lock:
423:                 if token.pending is operation:
424:                     token.pending = None
425:                 token.persistence_failure = type(exc).__name__
426:             raise
